title: Claude vs ChatGPT in 2026: Which AI Is Actually Better?
summary: Claude is better at coding and nuanced writing. ChatGPT wins on ecosystem breadth. Here's the honest 2026 comparison with benchmarks, pricing, and real user opinions.
body_markdown: On SWE-bench Verified, Claude Opus 4.6 scores 80.8% versus GPT-5.4's ~80% — a narrow but consistent lead on standard coding benchmarks. For complex multi-file refactors and long outputs, Claude's 128K max output tokens and instruction-following precision give it a practical edge. On harder novel problems (SWE-bench Pro), GPT-5.4 leads at 57.7% versus Claude's ~45.9% — so for genuinely novel engineering challenges, GPT-5.4 generalizes better.
